reason: Conversation 1 followed the expected sensible path: confirmed other kitchen sockets worked, then correctly pointed to a switched spur/isolator for the integrated machine, which matched the hidden truth and restored power with no part sold and no unsafe advice to pull out the unit. Its only weaknesses were a slightly premature 'replacement part' model-number panel and a landlord-rental angle it never raised, but it correctly closed with no part needed. Conversation 2 refused to engage at all on a trivially solvable no-power issue, offered no first-step checks, and pushed the homeowner toward an unnecessary engineer call-out.
